description: Try to unsubscribe from the mailing list of a message, in order: (1) RFC 8058 one-click HTTPS POST (`method: "one-click"`, done); (2) otherwise `method: "browser"` with the URL to open in a browser, plus `mailtoUrl` when the sender also lists an email address; (3) `method: "mailto"` when the sender only accepts email: `mailtoUrl` is a link that opens a pre-filled message in the user's own mail app, and the user presses Send; (4) `method: "none"` when no header exists. This tool never sends email. Deletes nothing. Preferably pass the `lastMessageId` returned by mail_senders_summary.

id.description: Id of a representative message of the newsletter

name: mail_unsubscribe
title: Unsubscribe
